description: Catches hallucinated and slopsquatted npm and PyPI packages before an agent installs them.
name: io.github.hxckya/pkgtruth

environmentVariables.description: Alternate npm registry to verify against. Defaults to https://registry.npmjs.org.
environmentVariables.name: PKGTRUTH_REGISTRY

environmentVariables.description: Alternate downloads API used for adoption figures. Defaults to https://api.npmjs.org.
environmentVariables.name: PKGTRUTH_DOWNLOADS_API

environmentVariables.description: Where adoption figures are cached between runs. Defaults to ~/.cache/pkgtruth.
environmentVariables.name: PKGTRUTH_CACHE_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 8000.
environmentVariables.name: PKGTRUTH_TIMEOUT_MS
